scope: Six independent fixed-scale offscreen quality sequences; 145 serial render frames with fixed 1/60 simulation steps and twelve sampled readbacks per arm. Not continuous video, panel presentation or a performance trial.
visual_verdict: Matched scene rendering, readable native UI, HDR reconstruction and reset-frame identity are demonstrated on this fixture. Temporal half is softer in motion and visibly jagged immediately after reset; third resolution loses more detail. Held cut16 samples settle substantially. Immediate native quality and full continuous temporal stability are not established.

provenance.metal_api_validation: Each log records Metal API Validation Enabled; parent launched with MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1.
provenance.panel_or_lock_state: not applicable to offscreen image proof; not observed per run

validation.validator_source: Same frozen validator SHA as all six launch manifests; independent root/peer review remains separate.

cross_arm_matching.identity_note: Main/render/entity IDs are validated within each arm; they are not required to equal across independent processes.

visual_review.reviewer_role: Harness author; independent root and peer review is separate.
visual_review.native_sdr_and_hdr: Sharp facial strokes, ray silhouettes and rails; held post-cut images show the same settled pose. HDR main textures produce tone-mapped PNGs; this is not an HDR panel test.
visual_review.temporal_half_sdr: Moving sample is slightly softer than native but facial W/caret eyes and rays remain readable. Cut0 has conspicuous stair-stepping on rails, checker edges, faces and rays. Cut16 is much cleaner; no obvious retained old-pose overlay is visible at cut0.
visual_review.bilinear_half_sdr: Facial strokes, rays and rails remain visibly stepped in both motion and held cut16. Temporal after settling is smoother than this control.
visual_review.temporal_third_sdr: More motion softness and thin-rail breakup than half resolution. Cut0 has severe aliasing and degraded small facial strokes. Cut16 is substantially smoother but remains softer than half/native. This does not support treating third resolution as quality-equivalent to half.
visual_review.temporal_half_hdr: Matches the HDR-native composition and broad color appearance. Motion is softer, cut0 visibly jagged, and cut16 settled cleanly; no obvious old-pose overlay in the inspected reset frame.
visual_review.ui: Caption remains crisp and readable across the inspected arms, including heavily aliased Temporal cut0 scene pixels. This covers the fixture caption, not all Bevy UI materials or HDR display composition.

limits: Only twelve sampled PNGs per arm; no full continuous video or refresh-paced playback.
Initial ticks0..31 and post-cut128..144 hold poses; cut16 is not a moving recovery test.
Only one run per quality arm; no perceptual score threshold or blinded quality study.
No .58, two-thirds or .75 quality arms in this archive.
No reset-disabled comparison, transparency stress, production pacing, adaptive governor or frame-generation claim.
MTL_DEBUG_LAYER validates API use, not visual correctness or GPU-cost instrumentation.
